title: ageratina hederifolia
intro: Ageratina hederifolia, commonly known as American Ironwort, is a plant species that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from menstrual cramps, fever reduction, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina hederifolia include its analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ageratina hederifolia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
